messages.body: You asked what 'fleet-wide frozen survivor-biased universe; dip-buy amplification' is. Plain English: the backtest picked stocks from a list of companies as it exists TODAY. Companies that went broke or were delisted during the tested years are missing from that list, so the test could never buy them — it only ever saw the survivors. That can only make results look better. 'Dip-buy amplification' means it hits your Oakwind strategies hardest: a dip-buyer is exactly the strategy that would have bought the failing companies the frozen list deletes. This is a MEASURED finding from a three-lens audit that covered every sealed strategy in the estate, quoted below, and the full audit text is one click away — no sign-in.

evidence.quote: VERIFIED FLEET-WIDE (workflow w4nfwu675, 3 lenses). Refute-lens: CONFIRMED survivor-biased (no valid refutation). Fleet-lens: ALL sealed strategies AFFECTED — every committed backtest ranks within a frozen current-listed pool ... Oakwind (TS500_CSV present-day roster)

messages.body: You asked what a '6yr frozen universe cache' is and why anything frozen would hold value. It wouldn't — that is exactly why it is flagged. Plain English: the backtest simulated 2020-2026 but picked stocks from ONE list resolved on 2026-04-05. For the whole simulated six years it could only ever choose companies that were still alive in April 2026. The fleet audit rates TS500's version of this the most severe in the estate. Verbatim finding and full audit one click below.

You asked what a 'shadow paper fill' is versus TriSight Sim / TradeStation Sim / TradeStation Live. INFERRED: 'shadow' means the strategy runs silently alongside production — its signals are recorded and priced by TriSight's own engine, but no orders go anywhere, not even to a simulated broker account. So in your taxonomy it is a TriSight Sim lane, one step more detached than a normal sim. If your venue answer on the Oakwind Swing question says otherwise, that answer wins. Your four confirmations on this strategy's claim cards are recorded — thank you, they are the first four confirmed inputs in the study.
